description:
LA MAISON 

Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.

Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.

description:
Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances.
We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services.
We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result.

What is your Day to Day Mission:
Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them.

Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud.

Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems.

Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles.

description:
About the role:
As a Working Student in Program Management, you play an active role in bringing our customer demonstrations and strategic demo projects to life.
With a strong focus on Demo Management, you help bring our technology into the field and in front of our customers. You work closely with our Demo Project Lead and cross-functional teams, coordinate key activities, and make sure that people, systems, equipment, logistics, and timelines come together at the right time.
You will be directly involved in some of our most strategically important demonstrations while also taking full ownership of selected smaller demos, projects, and workstreams yourself.
This role is not just about coordination from your desk: you will be part of the action – from the first planning session to successful execution onsite.

What is your Day to Day Mission:
You play an active role in our Demo Management activities, turning customer requirements and demo ideas into well-planned and successfully executed demonstrations.

You work side-by-side with our Demo Project Lead on strategically important demos, coordinating activities across teams and keeping an eye on timelines, responsibilities, resources, and open actions.

You take end-to-end ownership of selected smaller demos, projects, and workstreams – from initial planning and coordination through execution and follow-up.

description:
Über Valova
Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann.
Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben, während die meisten deutschen Kliniken bereits rote Zahlen schreiben.
Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden. Erst Deutschland, dann Europa.
Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up-Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf dich!
Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist
Mit Valova kodieren Kliniken ihre Fälle schon heute deutlich schneller. Und das ist erst der Anfang: Wir bauen Valova Schritt für Schritt über die Kodierung hinaus aus, und jede Erweiterung muss im Klinikalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo.
Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Du findest heraus, wo Kodierteams Zeit und Erlöse verlieren, entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes bauen, und bringst es mit unserem Engineeringteam live. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten.

description:
“This is not your typical B2G role.”
B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you own it. You'll be responsible for a big share of RIZM's funding sources, with real influence on RIZM's cash flow and on how fast we grow. You'll be tapping into new sources that most companies never even look at.
Why this role exists
RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're looking for someone to own B2G as a business line at RIZM, from public funding all the way to municipalities as paying customers.
What you'll own
Public funding as a growth channel. Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: build the pipeline, actively own and track our running programmes, forge consortia and get applications approved.

Connect research. Coordinate our research collaboration with Stanford and translate it into funded projects.

Build the machine, AI-first. Set up your own systems, tracking and automation, so one person can run a funding pipeline that usually takes a whole team. You decide how the role works behind the scenes.

Take over and scale ReNET-EV. Own our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region) and roll the model out to more…

description:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. 

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. We are hiring a Researcher to advance the world models at the core of Asimov's ability to perceive, predict, and act. You will work at the intersection of self-supervised representation learning, predictive architectures, and embodied control, in close collaboration with our platform, firmware, and hardware teams.

Design, train, and rigorously evaluate world models that let Asimov predict the consequences of actions across visual, proprioceptive, and force/torque modalities.

Advance our self-supervised learning stack for visual and sensor representations, building on and extending the JEPA family (V-JEPA, I-JEPA, and related predictive-embedding approaches).

Prototype and benchmark generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs) against JEPA-style objectives for embodied prediction and planning.

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

The Airbnb Communications team is responsible for telling Airbnb’s story around the world. 

We help drive consideration and usage of our products and services in addition to generating buzz, supporting the legitimization of our community, and promoting trust in our brand. We lead the communications strategy to make Airbnb synonymous with magical travel and the world’s leading platform for hospitality entrepreneurs. 

We speak to the media, influencers, hosts and guests, industry commentators, thought leaders and the wider community - we are the voice of Airbnb. We’re a fast growing, high-energy team with a passion for people, places and great stories. If you’d like to be part of one of the world’s greatest teams, come tell us your story.

The Difference You Will Make:

We are hiring a Senior Communications Manager for Korea. This role leads policy and corporate reputation communications in Korea. description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. description:

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET
About Claims
AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.
We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.
The team
Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.
Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

To avoid the worst effects of climate change, most climate models agree the world will need to dramatically reduce emissions and remove 5-10 billion tons of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere per year by 2050. The Climate team’s goal is to accelerate Stripe’s path to net zero in parallel with the world’s. We do this by reducing Stripe’s emissions and leading initiatives to increase the likelihood we build sufficient carbon removal capacity to reach global climate goals.

In 2019, we developed the first measurement of Stripe’s emissions. In 2021 we launched Stripe Climate, enabling merchants to direct a fraction of their revenue to help scale emerging carbon removal technologies. In 2022 we launched Frontier, an advance market commitment to buy $1.8B+ of permanent carbon removal by 2040. In 2024, we entered our first multi-year offtake for clean energy.

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are
About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly.

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge —you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low-latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Difference You will Make:

Airbnb is seeking a CS Delivery Excellence Manager to support the global Delivery function. This is a full time position based in Ireland. The Delivery Excellence Manager role is a people manager position. They own and drive optimization initiatives within Global Delivery (design & launch of a competency framework, review of teams ways of working, …) as well as contribute to the successful operationalization of strategic CS programs within our frontline teams (operationalization of a new service line / channel, launch of product features, change in a workflow / training, ….)

They need a high level of expertise in managing operational teams, performance management, project management, and a deep understanding of customer service operations from a product, process & people standpoint.

Bring operational expertise to Customer Support initiatives & be the voice of the frontline teams

The Community You Will Join

The Cities team leads the work necessary to implement the regulatory products and processes needed globally to comply with regulations, and does so in a manner that also sustainably supports Airbnb's growth.

Within Cities, this role owns Airbnb's platform regulatory compliance program across EMEA — the growing set of EU and UK obligations that sit alongside, and increasingly beyond, short-term rental regulation.

The Difference You Will Make

As Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA, you are the accountable owner for a portfolio of platform regulations that is expanding in scope, scrutiny, and consequence — including the Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act, and more.

You will translate each obligation into a durable operating process, a defensible reporting methodology, or a product change — and serve as a trusted advisor to Legal, Policy, and Product leadership on how Airbnb meets its regulatory commitments in the region.
